eventMetadata.context_description: Oklahoma City Thunder host the New York Knicks in a pivotal late-season NBA matchup at Paycom Center, with OKC clinging to the Western Conference's top seed at 57-15 entering play amid a dominant campaign fueled by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's MVP-caliber scoring and elite defense. Knicks, battling for Eastern playoff positioning, arrive shorthanded after official injury reports listed Landry Shamet (knee, out) and Miles McBride (ankle, out), thinning their backcourt depth behind Jalen Brunson. Thunder stars SGA and Josh Hart were cleared from questionable tags, enhancing their rest advantage following a lighter schedule. OKC's home-court edge, superior net rating, and head-to-head trends underpin trader sentiment in this high-stakes clash with seeding implications.
